name: lever assisted chin-up
description: A machine that helps lift your body weight so you can train chin-ups at a lower load. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set the assistance, then kneel on the pad.
Grip the close handles with your palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull yourself up, driving your elbows down toward your sides.
Bring your chin above the handles.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
